title: iOS and Samsung Galaxywatch problem
body:
So Im having trouble with Samsung health app on iOS system. I have iPhone 7 Plus with iOS 13.3.1 and Samsung Galaxy 46mm watch with  Tizen version 4.0.0.7 and all last system updates. The Phone and Watch connects trough bluetooth and shows up in settings, and also the Galaxy Watch app syncs, but Samsung Health can’t sync properly.
I checked all settings as app developer recomends, but nothing helps. 
I read that other users have same problem, and there was a solution but the solution works only once, if I want to check the data again, I need to restart the phone and watch again, which really is annoying.
I discovered, that one of the solutions, that helps sync is shortly switch off and on bluetooth on iPhone. But it is only a temporary solution. 
Also lately Ive noticed that something is using more watch batery than it should. When I bought it lasted 4days with a charge, but now it barely lasts for 2days with single charging. GPS and WI-FI I switched on for short time, only when I try to sync or when I do my workout. Screen brightness is set to minimum. NFC is off. 
My problems started when I reset my watch to factory settings. Whatch was asking for system updates. So I was forced to update it from Tizen version 4.0.0.4 to 4.0.0.7.  And thats when the watch started to misbehave. 
My son has same model phone and watch with same settings. On Tizen vers 4.0.0.4 he hasn’t got any problems as I did before updates. His watch lasts twice longer with same charging. 
Can I get a fix for this in nearest time, or it’s not worth it and users should just switch to other smartwatches?

title: IOS + samsung watch
body:
Samsung watch app works great. Samsung health app doesnt fully sync data with watch until you restart that watch. It will sync all data for few hours and then it will say that no device connected to app. But samsung watch works fine meanwhile with my watch device. It’s frustrating that I need to restart watch every 2-3 hours to get data synced with Health app. This app feels like beta version. And backup & restore function - what is that? It only backups weather forecast and notifications :D who neeed that? Why doesnt it backup my fitness data and settings? Last night in global steps challenge I had 191 000 steps. I deleted Health app from my phone and installed back because my watch couldnt sync with this app. After reinstall I lost all steps data. Somehow now i have only 101 000 steps in global challenge. I have no records of my workouts - nothing. Meanwhile in my watch I can see everything. So backup doesnt work, sync struggles to work. It’s quite bad :( 
Why cant watch and this app sync in the way that both devices shows the same information? If I have worked out past few weeks then why cant Health app download that data from watch device?

How Samsung imagines stealing Apple users if they provide product that bad?

Still the same problem after all updates. Does Samsung even cares?

3rd edit

I already sent error reports and debug data from watch and health app to Samsung help center. I recorded video and screenshots. Samsung help already has all that information. Still - it’s more than 1 month and nothing has changed.
No wait - after last firmware update my watch is using 2-3% battery in hour when idle. Before update I could get 4-5 days battery time. Right now it’s less than 2 days. Samsung watch app shows that Health app is using battery the most. But health app isn’t working properly. What else can I do? 
Factory resets and app reinstalls are done already
